items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: We joined the show from Carbondale, Illinois... And we went over to the show with Miss Young -- on the show with her. And we stayed on that show until it closed.

ctx.x: Yeah. So he was going... He said, "Deak, you and Pete, I'm gonna take you all with me. I'm going over with Miss Young." He said, "I'm going to leave this show here with Kitchen."
